JABVOX_VOICE_BROADCAST.TITLE: Voice Broadcast
JABVOX_VOICE_BROADCAST.SUBTITLE: Outbound voice campaigns: call the contacts of a dialer campaign and play an audio message.
JABVOX_VOICE_BROADCAST.EMPTY: Create your first campaign to start calling.
JABVOX_VOICE_BROADCAST.AUDIO_DEPLOYED: Audio uploaded and deployed to the PBX.
JABVOX_VOICE_BROADCAST.AUDIO_UPLOADED_NOT_DEPLOYED: Audio uploaded, but it could not be deployed to the PBX.

HISTORY.EMPTY: No broadcasts in the selected range.

REPORTS.EMPTY: No data for the selected range.

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.FILTER_HINT: No filters = all leads with a phone number.
FORM.AUDIO_NOTE: The audio to play is uploaded from the campaign detail ("Open" button), in the Audio section. First create the campaign; then upload and deploy the audio before starting.
FORM.ERROR: Could not save the voice campaign.

HINT.NAME: Internal name to identify this campaign in the list, history and reports.
HINT.CALLER_ID: The number shown to the person receiving the call. Leave empty to use the number configured in your VoIP trunk.
HINT.MAX_CONCURRENT: Maximum number of calls active at the same time. More = the campaign finishes sooner, but heavier load on the PBX and trunk.
HINT.CPS: New calls launched per second (CPS). A high rate can overload the trunk; start low (1–2) and raise it carefully.
HINT.MAX_RETRIES: How many times to retry contacts who did not answer or were busy. 0 = a single attempt per contact.
HINT.RETRY_INTERVAL: Seconds to wait before dialing a contact who didn't answer again. 300s = 5 minutes.
HINT.HOURS: Time window during which calls are allowed (account time zone). Leave empty for no time restriction.
HINT.AMD: Detects whether a person or a voicemail/machine answered, so the audio isn't played to a machine. May add 1–2s before playback.
HINT.DTMF: Lets the person receiving the call press a key to opt out of the campaign (stop receiving these calls).
HINT.DTMF_DIGIT: Key the person must press to opt out (default 9).

DETAIL.AUDIO_NONE: No audio. Upload a file before starting.
DETAIL.NEED_AUDIO: Upload and deploy the audio to be able to start.
